name: 3단 팜플렛
description: A4 가로를 3단으로 나눈 안내 팜플렛(제품·서비스 소개)

design.css: .sheet { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 100vh; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--fs-backgroundColor); color: var(--fs-textColor); }.panel { flex: 1; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 44px 34px; border-right: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--fs-mutedColor) 40%, transparent); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }.panel:last-child { border-right: 0; }h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--fs-primaryColor); font-size: 22px; }.panel p { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--fs-textColor); }.contact { margin-top: auto !important; color: var(--fs-mutedColor); font-weight: 600; }.cover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fs-primaryColor) 8%, var(--fs-backgroundColor)); justify-content: center; }.cover-img { width: 100%; max-height: 300px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 14px; margin-bottom: 22px; }.brand { color: var(--fs-primaryColor); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; font-size: 15px; }h2 { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.25; }
